description_en: APARTMENT 2+1 FOR SALE, SQUARE 21! 2+1 apartment for sale at Square 21. The apartment is part of a sought-after and highly preferred residence. Neat and usable floor plan. It is organized in a corridor that distributes: living room with kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, balcony. Order contracts are available. Contact for more details!
